issue.title: Day-long reviewAnsweredKeys path:line keys can name a different row after a line-shifting edit
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `reviewAnsweredKeys` in plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/536-plugin-review-advance.js (read in `continueReviewWalkAfter` / `advanceReviewWalkAfterAnswer`, written by `addReviewAnsweredKeys`)

`reviewAnsweredKeys` stores `path:line` keys for the whole day, so any later line-shifting edit can make a stored key name a different, still-due row, and later advances then treat that row as handled. Examples are hand inserts and a recurring task's completion inserting the next occurrence above it.

Repro: land `]s` on a due row, answer it (any advancing answer) so its `path:line` key enters `reviewAnsweredKeys`, then insert a new due task line above a later due row in the same note so that row inherits the stored key, then answer another row and advance — the shifted row is skipped as already handled.

Impact: the review walk can silently skip due rows for the rest of the day after ordinary line-shifting edits; recovery is `[s` or `<C-o>`, but the skip is silent.

task_type_fields.impact: Later advances silently treat an unreviewed due row as handled for the rest of the day.
task_type_fields.repro: Land ]s, answer to store a path:line key, insert a due line above a later due row so it inherits the key, answer again and advance — the shifted row is skipped as handled.

issue.creation_reason: Plan plan:202610/ctrl_shift_m_never_advances_walk.md step 10 exposed this general fragility while fixing the move-specific case; the move fix deliberately does not write reviewAnsweredKeys, but other line-shifting edits still can.

payload.entry: Fixed by review-walk text identity (nav 2.7.1): position comes only from this gesture's rows, handled keys verify by note+text, neighbours resolve by text refs. Covered by test-navigation-review-advance.cjs walk-identity tests (stale accumulator, lagging row, line-shifting answer, legacy anchors, text-first stamp match, collectReviewAnswerKeys) and test-navigation-review-advance-gestures.cjs (answer-move-answer order, stale-alias park, re-indexed origin).
